title: Dues for a Reinstated Comfort Club Term
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — dues of a reinstated term.**

## Rule
The dues of an annually billed agreement reinstated within its renewal grace period are billed and paid by the member in one payment for the reinstated term, which runs from the day after the lapsed term ended. Fees standing on the agreement are billed separately.

The dues of a reinstated term are fixed only after the agreement shows active status with a term starting the day after the lapsed term ended.

The dues of a reinstated term are not billed until the price lock for that term has been decided.

The dues of a reinstated term are not fixed until the dues ledger carries a missed-visit fee for every visit forfeited in the lapsed term.

## System entry: `pay_reinstated_term_dues_c2f743bd`
Paying the dues is the member's own action. The agent unlocks `pay_reinstated_term_dues_c2f743bd` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, in person, to pay the dues of the current term of their agreement. The dues given are billed to the agreement as the renewal dues of its current term and the member's payment of the same amount is recorded with a processor confirmation number, so the two entries together leave the dues balance unchanged.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the member's Comfort Club agreement, as the agent reads it from the agreement lookup and gives it to the member | Identifier |
| `payment_method` | How the member pays | One of the values below |
| `term_dues` | Dues of the agreement's current term billed and paid | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded to the cent by the caller |

**`payment_method` values**
- `card_on_file` — the member uses the card already stored on the account;
- `ach_autopay` — the member pays from the bank account set up for automatic drafts;
- `card_by_phone` — the member reads out a card during the call;
- `check` — the member pays by mailed check;
- `original_payment_method` — the payment returns to the method used originally; this applies only to payouts and never to a member's own payment.

### Return
The receipt carries `agreement_id`, `charge_entry_id` (reference number of the dues charge), `payment_entry_id` (reference number of the payment), `payment_reference` (processor confirmation number, which the member receives), `term_dues` (USD, 2 decimal places), `dues_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, signed) and `status`, always "paid".
